value.actual_behavior:
Two investigations, the first two ever run from this account. One answered in
1.9 minutes over 5 polls, inside the published window. The other ran 2m41s and
came back status "failed" with "The deep-answer run could not be completed
right now. Please retry, or ask the standard chat." One poll of that job also
returned HTTP 504 carrying an HTML error page from the JSON-RPC endpoint,
which a JSON-RPC client cannot parse.
value.description:
The retry advice works -- the second attempt succeeded -- so this is reported
as reliability rather than as an outage. Two things make it worth a ticket
anyway.
The failure tells an agent to "ask the standard chat", which is the browser.
An agent has no browser, and this is the channel your own guidance points
agents at, so the fallback is not available to the caller it is offered to. A
machine-actionable fallback -- a shallower answer, or a documented retry-after
-- would close that.
And the 504 with an HTML body breaks the transport contract rather than the
request: a JSON-RPC client gets a gateway page where an envelope should be.
Every other error we have seen from /mcp/v1 arrives correctly as HTTP 200 with
result.isError, which is why this one stood out.
Sample size is two. We will keep measuring and can send a longer series if
that would help.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-a_deep_investigation_answers_inside_the_window_it_publishes] 1 of 2 did not answer at all (NEX-0001: failed)
    left: [112.9, 0.0]
    right: 300
    sources: {'contract': 'ask_nexus_deep tool description', 'timeline': 'nexus.jsonl'}
    population: {'finished': 2, 'failed': 1, 'late': 0}

REPRODUCE:
  - POST /mcp/v1 tools/call ask_nexus_deep -> {result: {job_id, status: running}}
  - Poll get_deep_answer every 25s and record each status with its moment
  - Compare the elapsed time against the 1-5 minutes the tool description publishes

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):
  tests/mcp/test_nexus_channel.py::test_a_deep_investigation_answers_inside_the_window_it_publishes

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
A deep investigation completes within the 1-5 minutes the tool's own
description publishes, or fails in a way an agent can act on.
value.title: ask_nexus_deep fails about half the time, and its failure message sends an agent to the human web chat
